{{Quote|Hold your fire. There's no life forms. It must have short-circuited.|Gunnery Captain Bolvan, to Lieutenant Hija|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Bolvan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. He captained the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] under the command of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-produced [[Flesh-eating bacterium|bacterial plague]] began to spread out of control on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], Bolvan suggested the sterilization of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but Vader ordered an [[Bombardment of Falleen|orbital bombardment]] of the world instead. Later, in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while serving as [[Gunnery captain/Legends|gunnery captain]], Bolvan participated in the ''Devastator''{{'s}} [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], during which [[Chief gunnery officer/Legends|Chief Gunnery Officer]] [[Hija/Legends|Hija]] spotted an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] fleeing from the impounded Rebel vessel. However, Bolvan ordered him not to fire on the pod because the ''Devastator''{{'s}} [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected no lifeforms aboard.

==Biography==
===Falleen bombardment===
{{Quote|Lord Vader, there is no cure&hellip;|Captain Bolvan, to Darth Vader|<ref name="TLE">{{WEGCite|story=The Lesser Evil|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
[[File:Falleen-bombardment-SOTEE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Against Bolvan's suggestion, Darth Vader ordered the turbolaser bombardment of Falleen.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ANH" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] Bolvan was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="ANH novel" /> By [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]],<ref name="SOTES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="Note">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' reveals that the [[bombardment of Falleen]] was ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'', which occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> he [[Captain/Legends|captained]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|84|Bolvan, Captain}}</ref> the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], commanded by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TLE" /> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] arrived at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] as part of Vader's exploration tour visiting Imperial weapon development projects.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 69">{{FactFile|69|XIZ 1-4|Prince Xizor}}</ref> Bolvan informed Vader of an accident in a [[Bacteriological research outpost|biological research facility]] and the following spread of a [[flesh-eating bacterium]] across Falleen's surface. The Captain passed his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to Vader, showing him projections that were based on information salvaged from the laboratory and predicted the devastation of the whole planet in a short [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TLE" />

Bolvan suggested requisitioning the ordnance from [[Project X271]] and incinerating the plague from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], but Vader disagreed, because he did not wish to [[Speciecide|wipe out]] the entire [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Instead, Vader ordered an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the surface to halt any further spread of the leaking [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].<ref name="TLE" /> [[Chief gunnery officer/Legends|Chief Gunnery Officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hija/Legends|Hija]] was responsible for firing the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Bombardment of Falleen|bombardment]] from the ''Devastator'' that destroyed the weapons facility<ref name="TCSWE-Hija">{{CSWECite|II|42|Hija, Lieutenant}}</ref> and everything within forty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]<ref name="TLE" /> to cover up the mishap.<ref name="TCSWE-Hija" /> Among the 200,000 Falleen [[Death/Legends|casualties]] in the ensuing destruction was the [[House Sizhran|family]] of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who later led the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization.<ref name="SOTES" />

===Capture of the ''Tantive IV''===
{{Quote|Don't waste your power.|Gunnery Captain Bolvan, to Lieutenant Hija|<ref name="ANH novel SE">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] foreword by [[George Lucas]]</ref>}}
[[File:Bolvan-Hija-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bolvan instructs Lieutenant Hija not to fire on the escape pod.]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Bolvan still served on the ''Devastator''.<ref name="ANH" /> However, by this time, Captain [[Mulchive Wermis]]<ref name="VG3">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 3: Imperial Boarding Party}} [https://web.archive.org/web/20210312094053/https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=195566271381&set=a.195564781381.126451.195552901381 Picture here]</ref> had assumed the position of the ''Devastator''{{'s}} [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], and Bolvan was in charge of the main weaponry as [[Gunnery captain/Legends|gunnery captain]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> In that year, after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents transmitted stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to the Rebel [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[consular ship]], the ''Devastator'' pursued and [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] the Rebel [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] over the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH" />

Bolvan was listening to the reports on the proceedings aboard the captured Rebel vessel as the last pockets of resistance were dealt with. Several [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] had been jettisoned from the ''Tantive IV'' during the battle, and, spotting another one, Lieutenant Hija called Bolvan for instructions. Hija spotted the pod that, unbeknownst to the Imperials, contained the Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the latter of whom carried the stolen [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] plans in his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]]. However, since the ''Devastator''{{'s}} [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected no lifeforms within the escape pod, Bolvan believed the pod's release mechanism must have short-circuited or received a false instruction. So, Bolvan ordered Hija to hold his fire in order to conserve power, allowing the droids to escape. Bolvan then returned to the reports listing the captured men and material coming from the Rebel ship.<ref name="ANH novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Captain, you must learn when it is appropriate to offer your counsel. Now is not the time.|Darth Vader, to Captain Bolvan|<ref name="TLE" />}}
As a captain during the incident on Falleen, Bolvan was thorough and merciless in his desire to incinerate the plague from orbit, even at the cost of genocide, contrary to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's final orders. He approached Vader, his superior, gingerly during the Falleen incident, pleading in opposition to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], who warned him to learn to offer his counsel at a more appropriate time.<ref name="TLE" />

By 0 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> Bolvan served the Empire in a lower commission as gunnery captain.<ref name="TCSWE" /> He was less thorough in dealing with the escape pod fleeing the ''Tantive IV'', however. Bolvan relaxed considerably at his post once the ''Tantive IV'' was secured and listened with pleasure and satisfaction to the reports from the Rebel ship. He was confident in the firepower and total control of his command, and read the sensor data of the escaping pods casually.<ref name="ANH novel" /> The gunnery crews of the ''Devastator'' had a surprising amount of autonomy,<ref name="sta3">{{FactFile|11|STA 3-4|Imperial Star Destroyer}}</ref> and Bolvan's poor judgment in ordering Lieutenant Hija not to open fire on a pod that showed no signs of housing lifeforms in exchange for sparing energy effectively allowed the droid R2-D2 to escape with the Death Star plans.<ref name="ANH novel" /> Bolvan chose to wear the prominent sideburns that were popular among [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="tjas">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bolvan first appeared in the [[December]] [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH novel" /> ghost-written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="ANH novel SE" />

The revised fourth draft script of ''A New Hope'',<ref name="BTM" /><ref name="Art of Star Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]''</ref><ref name="Annotated">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> as well as the film's novelization, refers to Bolvan as "Captain" in relation to the ''Devastator''.<ref name="ANH novel" /> However, the [[March 21]], [[1979]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Marvel Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Star Wars (1977) 21|''Star Wars'' (1977) 21]] identified the captain of Vader's Star Destroyer as [[Mulchive Wermis]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 21">[[Star Wars (1977) 21|''Star Wars'' (1977) 21]]</ref> [[West End Games]]' ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' in [[1996]] named Bolvan the captain of the ''Devastator''.<ref name="TLE" /> In [[2007]], the fourth chapter of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Visual Guides]] feature first identified Bolvan as the black-uniformed [[Officer/Legends|officer]] from ''A New Hope'' who orders Hija not to fire on the escape pod and Wermis as the captain of the ''Devastator''.<ref name="VG3" /> Finally, in [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', in order to [[Retroactive continuity|solve]] the issue of two captains on the same ship, established Bolvan as the ship's gunnery captain.<ref name="TCSWE" />
